title: Microsoft PowerPoint Basics
intro: Learn how to create professional presentations, add slides, insert media and present information clearly.
topic1_text: Learn about slides, layouts, ribbons, menus and the basic tools used in PowerPoint.
topic2_text: Learn how to add new slides, choose designs and organize your presentation content.
topic3_text: Learn how to insert pictures, videos and other media to make presentations more engaging.
topic4_text: Learn how to start a slideshow and present your ideas confidently.
practice: Create a simple presentation about yourself or your learning journey.
